notes: Ten part-level events are reported. “On” denotes an opened state and “off” denotes a closed state. The two independently movable upper-cabinet leaves are listed separately; their exact individual ordering during the rapid closing interval is only approximately resolved.
scene_description: Wide-angle first-person traversal of a studio apartment, primarily its entry and kitchen. The user successively opens and closes a coat closet, several appliance doors, both leaves of an upper cabinet, a drawer, two refrigerator compartments, and a laundry closet.
